events.title: Update Alpha 0.5.7 Demo: Map Notes, Camera Panning and Better Controls
events.summary: ARCOSTATE - DEVLOG 11Hi all, small update with bug fixes, changes, and quality of life improvements. Also, steam deck support is in the works!CHANGES- Campfires and burning barrels can now be used to cook.- Some NPC categories have been merged under a new Misc. section in the codex.- Arcology sinks can now be used to fill water containers.- Hold Ctrl and use the movement keys or drag with the middle mouse button to pan the camera.- The look cursor now scrolls the camera when it reaches the edge

events.title: Arcostate Demo Out Now!
events.summary: The Arcostate demo is out now on Steam!The demo covers the starting region and runs up to level 15. The free full version is no longer available on itch.io, as the full game will be planned to move into a paid release on Steam and itch.io.Saves from the free full version cannot be loaded in the demo.The demo will also be part of Steam Next Fest in October.Thank you to everyone who played the free builds and sent bug reports.
